sample_input: Please share your feedback on the new checkout flow. The page feels faster, but the payment error message is unclear, and I had to retry twice before it worked.

輸出不會省略原文中明顯存在的重要資訊。
若輸入包含多句回饋，輸出仍然是先翻譯整段，再摘要成三點。
